case_title: ANDARY JOSIANE VS NORDSTROM DISTRIBUTION CENTER

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY ANDARY JOSIANE AS TO DEFENDANT NORDSTROM DISTRIBUTION CENTER ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-13-1992 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERTIFIED RECEIPT TO DIRA PELMORE (NORDSTROM) RETURNED NOT SIGNED BY ADDRESSEE.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ANDARY JOSIANE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT NORDSTROM DISTRIBUTION CENTER $4,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $13.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,013.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
